item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 03/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Temperatures will rise slightly over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A surge of northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Wednesday. It will be slightly cooler with one or two rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the subsequent dry continental airstream, it will be mainly fine over Guangdong in the latter part of this week. An easterly airstream will bring a few rain patches to the coastal areas over the weekend.
